text: Please find below the recommendations prepared by Transportation Services Staff. I have met with the Foxbar Neighbourhood Association and residents of the Bradgate Arms Retirement Home located at 64 Foxbar Road who have agreed on the following amendments to introduce pay and display parking for the portion of Foxbar Road on the west side of the street from the Bradgate Arms Retirement Residence and St. Clair Ave West. These amendments will allow visitors of the residents of Bradgate Arms the opportunity to park this portion of Foxbar Road. The rest of the parking on Foxbar Road will remain as permit parking only.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. Monday to Friday on the west side of Foxbar Road between St Clair Avenue West and a point 83 metres south. 2. Authorized the installation of parking machines on the west side of Foxbar Avenue, between St Clair Avenue West and a point 83 metres south, to operation from 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, and 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., Sunday, for a maximum period of three hours at a rate of $3.00 per hour.
